description: Get your live open positions across connected exchanges (MEXC, Binance, Lighter). Shows entry price, mark price, unrealized PnL, leverage, margin, and liquidation price for each position. Requires exchange API keys to be configured — add them via /exchange_apis in the Asrai Telegram bot. Use when asked: 'show my positions', 'what am I trading', 'my open trades', 'my PnL', 'my exchange positions'.
name: positions
